Combined in-game test vehicle for the engine-native SM events decoded from Skyrim.esm (no Papyrus). One plugin, three independent quests — each hangs under a DIFFERENT vanilla event root, so they never compete (the 'one event -> one quest' iron law is per-root). Install, enable, then trigger each and check `sqv <editorId>`:
  - MFSM_OnCraft  : craft anything at any station        -> Workbench filled
  - MFSM_OnRemove : drop/sell/give an item                 -> Item + Owner filled
  - MFSM_OnArrest : commit a crime and get arrested         -> Criminal + Guard filled
Each is unconditional, so it starts on the FIRST occurrence after install (use a fresh save or save/reload). Add `storyEvent.conditions` to gate to specific recipes/items/holds. (All three in-game confirmed 2026-06-05.)
